summary: Frontend-only validation of iteration 10 changes for Laboratorios Horvath landing (React + FastAPI + MongoDB). Verified 12 patient profile cards with background images, new empresas 'porque-aliarse' persuasive section with badge 15% and CTAs, Home reduced to 2 contact buttons, new alianzas partner logos marquee (15 images), modal open/close (button, Escape, overlay), como-flow (4 steps) on /pacientes and /empresas, ES/EN language toggle including new empresas.porque translations, mobile 390x844 layout, and /api/health backend check. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: ProfileExplorer.jsx correctly applies background-image inline styles both on cards (.perfil-card.has-image) and modal head (.perfil-modal-head); Escape + overlay + close-button all wired via setActiveId(null).
Empresas 'porque-aliarse' section renders 4 .porque-card, .benefit-highlight-badge shows '15%', both CTAs are valid wa.me links.
Partners marquee uses ALIANZA_LOGOS with 15 images duplicated to 30 for infinite scroll (as expected).
No hardcoded URLs found; frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Assets are static under /assets/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 perfil-card have background images (verified salud-femenina-premium, perfil-deportista, its-basico, pre-natal-completo — assets 200 OK). Modal head has background-image inline style via .perfil-modal-head (class name, not header/.modal-header). Escape/overlay/perfil-close all close modal when given >=1s for framer-motion animations. Home /home-contact-actions has exactly 2 buttons (home-wa-btn wa.me + home-contact-btn -> /contacto). Partners marquee srcs are /assets/alianzas/alianza-01..15.jpg (30 img tags due to duplication for marquee, all 200). Empresas porque-aliarse: eyebrow 'Aliate a Horvath' (ES) / 'Partner with Horvath' (EN), title 'Sumate a las empresas líderes...', 4 .porque-card, .benefit-highlight with .benefit-highlight-badge='15%', porque-asesor + Solicitar una propuesta both wa.me. Como-flow on /pacientes and /empresas each show 4 steps. Mobile 390x844: whatsapp-float visible; back-to-top only after scroll; no overlap; cards 1 column; benefit-highlight stacks to full width (342px). /api/health returns 200 {status:healthy}.
